entry.name: jit.framecount
entry.description: Outputs the count of frames as they are rendered by the attached context.

attributes.name: annotation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: automatic
attributes.digest: Automatic update and output
attributes.description: Enables automatic update and output (default = 1). Requires a validcontext for synching with. When disabled updates and output require a bang message.

attributes.name: drawto
attributes.digest: Bind to named drawing context.
attributes.description: Bind to the named drawing context, allowing for updates to be received automatically whenis enabled.

attributes.name: enable
attributes.digest: Enable output
attributes.description: Enables output of frame count values (default = 1).

attributes.name: fixed_delta
attributes.digest: Fixed frame delta time for calculating time output (default = 0.0)
attributes.description: Fixed frame delta time for calculating time output (default = 0.0). When non-zero, time functions will use this value to calculate output, rather than the delta time since last update.This can be useful when animating at a fixed rate regardless of the actual update rate.
